annotations.text:
THIS IS THE ENERSOL MARK

You picked Hex Cell. It is now the logo everywhere — navbar, footer,
favicon, app icon — and it is swapped into all five screens on the
Screens page. Go look at it in the real navbar there; that is the
test that matters.

The two marks you didn't pick are parked on the "Not chosen" page
rather than deleted, in case you want to revisit.

NEXT, when you say go: I draw this as real SVG files
(logo.svg, logo-mark.svg, favicon.svg) plus a shared Logo component,
and wire it into the site along with the NexVolt to Enersol rename.

One thing to watch: the offset opening at the top is what makes this
mark yours, and it is the first thing to close up at small sizes.
Check the 16px sample before we commit.

NOT CHOSEN — kept for reference only

A (Charge E) and B (Solar Arc). Neither is used anywhere on the
Screens page any more. Say the word and I'll delete this page.

PRODUCT SHOTS: LOGO SWAPPED IN THE IMAGE

The hero and all three battery renders had NEXVOLT printed on the case.
I removed it and printed the Hex Cell mark in its place, in the image
itself — so nothing on the site carries the old brand any more.

That is a repair, not a replacement. These are still stills of one
battery. Worth budgeting a proper re-render per family, and the
e-bikes have no photography at all yet.

THIS BAND IS THE ACTUAL CHANGE

Four cards: two you can buy, two marked Coming soon with no link
and no hover lift. That is what makes the site read as a range
rather than a battery shop with a bike bolted on — and adding
solar later is just flipping one card's status.

THE CONTROLS HERE ACTUALLY WORK — CLICK THEM

Everything else on this canvas is a still mockup. This one is live so you
can feel the two-level structure: family tabs on top, that family's own
filters underneath.

Try: Electric Bikes (the two spec chips switch from Voltage/Capacity to
Motor/Range) · Solar or Inverters (a real panel, not an empty grid) ·
Batteries then Commercial (empty — you have no Commercial product yet,
and today's live site has that same dead filter in its footer).

The grid/list toggle and Clear filters work now too.

E-BIKE DETAIL PAGE — DELIBERATELY NOT A BATTERY

Built as a bike to prove the template generalises. Two things changed
from today's page:

1. The four-across strip under the hero now carries real numbers with
units (motor, range, top speed, pack) instead of feature labels with
battery icons.

2. Because of that, the feature list needed its own home — the
"What you get" section. That is the one section I added; say the word
and I'll fold it back into the strip instead.

Every figure in square brackets is a placeholder I invented. Send me
the real specs and prices and I'll drop them in.

PHONE WIDTH — 390px

Most of your traffic. The four families stack as two full cards
plus a two-up row for the pair that isn't live yet.

No fake status bar and no fake keyboard drawn — the real phone
puts those on top.

Every tap target is at least 44px (the two "View …" links were
24px in the first version — fixed).
